reason: The object-level N-API bridge adds a JSON serialization and parsing round-trip after Express has already parsed the response.
limitations: Synthetic response with text segments and function calls; no network, provider, or model latency.
The candidate is measured after JavaScript JSON.parse and therefore does not represent the planned raw-byte edge integration.
Absolute timings depend on host load; the result is a rollout guard, not an end-to-end performance claim.
